title: This felt so real
content: I went to a world with a giant red wheel with spikes that kept driving all of us out of this bizarre platform and throwing us into this endless blue pit, with the most ancient of structures just floating around. There was no pain or any feel involved. We were divided in pairs, I don't know by what kind of being. When we reached a certain point we would be respawned into the same platform. But most people would go to this parallel world, similar to ours, that they would gain access to some poin. There, I was the founder of a cult that teached that we should allow ourselves to be rendered by this strange world, not accomodate ourselves, and mainly a way to get out: hold your partner's hands and feel them as you both fall. ?????
